content: Siqifan Jianjisan
Zui fugie buwa Siqifande asawo, "Intu shiqin winu?"
Siqifan kieliewo, "Oqio kun, gaijiula, ta chenliendu. Matai xienren IburaheimuHalande soutula Meisobudamiyade bikude famatu Huda hhende xienjighadene kieliewo,
'Chi goya oron, jiawusene likai giezhi bi chade uzheghaku oronde echi.'"
"Ingie hhe Jialeji kunlai oronse likai giedene Halande souwo. Hhei adani fugudene Huda hhei banjighazhi ta ede sousan ene oronde ireghawo.
Ene oronde Huda hhende yama jiachan, lien beiku oronye uye ogiwoma, Huda kielien yenjizhi ene oronyi hhende, hhei houdeide ogizhi caichan gie giewo. Hhe shihoude hhende kewosi uwo.
Ingiese Huda kieliewo, 'Houdeichii kunlai oronde souzhi hoji danlazhi 400 nien zayalane.'
Pse kieliewo, 'Hhelai hoji danlaghasan gojiani bi panjine. Khuinashi hhela khizhedene ene oronde mii shunjine.'
Ingiedene Huda Iburaheimude hetoune giekughala kielien yenjiwo. Iburaheimude Isagheini oluzhi neimudude hetoune giewo. Isagheide Yagebuni oluwo, Yagebude mai 12 gie famatu xienrenlai oluwo."
"Ene famatu xienrenla Yusufu jiuni dubiliedene Aijide huiwo. Ingieliuzhe Huda hheghala hhantushi
hhei yan kunnanseliuzhe khizheghawo. Huda hhende nenjien, agheli ogise Aijini Falao honshan hhei uzhedan gou wo. Falao hhei Aijide zui fugie noyen danlaghazhi giene man gonjighawo."
"Ingiedene Aiji, Jianande honnien kuzhezhi zeinan irewo. Mai xienrenlade taran sirawo.
Yagebu sonosuse Aijide taran wine. Ingie mai xienrenlani peizhi tou 1 hui hhende echighawo.
2 huide echise Yusufu gaijiuladene tanighawo. Ingiese Falao hhei gieni qinkonyi mejiewo.
Yusufu kun peizhi adane nie gie kunyi jienlieghale echiwo. Man 75 gie kun wo.
Ingie YagebuAijide bouzhewo. Khuinashi Yagebu, mai xienrenla man hhende duya ijiewo.
Hhelai laizhi Shijiende echi IburaheimuHamoni houdeilase miengughala agisan mezade bulawo."
"Huda Iburaheimude yenjisan kielien kuzhekude Aijide Isilie kunla hende olodowo.
Khuinashi Yusufui tani dachen nie shini honshan khizhezhi Aijini gonjizho.
Hhe mai kunlai heizhi xienrenlai mai zayalazho. Hhelai biizhi yeliwalai bendaghazhi aminne ese olughazho."
"Hhe shihoude Musani oluwo. Hudai melie hhe uzhezhi seighan wo. Hhei adaini giede ghuran sara qiezhedene
bendase Falaoi oqin kewonni giedene qiezhe fugiedaghawo.
MusaAiji kunlai unhuani man suruwo. Kielien kielie, shiqin giese nenli wine."
"Musa 40 olukude goya Isilie kunlane uzhele echine giezhi jiejin giewo.
Niefade hhe echikude nie Aiji kun nie Isilie kunyi qifulasanyi chanlasenu hhe Aiji kunyi alazhi hhe kunde bouchou giewo.
Hhe sumulase Huda hhei tungo giezhi goya kunlai jiuikui mejiemu giezhoma, hhela mejie dazho.
Khuichudu Musa chanlase Isilie kunla eghinduzho. Hhelai sidaghazhi kieliewo, 'Gujiu, tashi gaijiula wo, yale nieniene qifulane?'"
"Giebeine qifulasan kun Musai tungu daogha kieliewo, 'Kien chii bijiende lindao, panjichen kun danlaghawo?
Chi uchughudu hhe Aiji kunyi alaku mutun mii alanu?'
Musa ene kielienyi chenliedene Aijise ghula holu Mijiende toreisan mutun souwo. Hhe oronde hhende ghua kewon oluwo."
"40 nien daose Xinaishan hontande nie qienxien siderasan eghesun dunda Musade chanlaghawo.
Musa zhoujin mutunyi chanladene ghanirazhi melie daozhi uzhene giekude Ezhanyi shenqii sonosuwo,
'Bishi chii xienrenlai Huda wo. Iburaheimu, Isaghei, Yagebuni Huda wo.' Musa chenliesenu pugharadene ayizhi uzhe dazho.
Ezhan hhende kieliewo, 'Chi kon jieredu maheine tei. Chi beisan oronshi zhiguitu oron wo.
Mii bexinlai Aijide zayalasanyi bi qinchude chanlawo. Hhela shonholosan shenqiiye sonosuwo. Bi hhelai jiuile bouzhewo. Ede ire, bi chii peizhi Aijide echighane.'"

"Eneshi bexinla kien chii bijiende lindao, panjichen kun danlaghawo giezhi fandui giesan Musa wo. Ingieliuzhe Huda siderasan eghesun dunda qienxienyi tungo giezhi hhei peidene bexinlade noyen, jiuichen danlaghawo.
MusaAiji, Hunhai, hontande 40 nien olon fugie shiqin, ghudureqi giezhi bexinlai Aijise uduru khizhewo."
"Eneshijiu Isilie kunlade 'Huda tai dundase bi mutun nie xienzhi khizheghane.' giezhi kieliesan hhe Musa wo.
Ene Musa hontandedu Isilie kunlare hhantu wo. Mai xienrenghala hhantu Xinaishan jiere hhende kielien kieliesan qienxienyi tungo giezhi amin ogiku kielienyi jienliedene matande chonjizhi ogiwo."
"Mai xienrenla hhei kielienyi ese chenliedene hhei tungu daoghazhi Aijide khareiku duralazho.
Hhela Hharunede kieliewo, 'Bijiende mo uduruku nigiedalani gie. Bijienyi Aijise uduru khizhesan Musa yan shiqin penji woshi bijien ulie mejiene.'
Ingie hhe shihoude hhela nie fughe giedene hhe nigiedade mure khughozhi goya khaghalane giesanlade beiizhi bayasunduzho.
Ingiese Huda hhelase likai giedene hhela asiman jieredu naran, sara, hodunlai beiise uye gonjizho. Zhen xienzhii shu jiere huaisan mutun,

content.text: zharusan ghoni fugheji pse ogisan mureshi made giesan pusho.
Ta qienliesanshi Molo nigiedani zhanfan wo,
Enelashi ta goyala beiine giezhi giesan nigiedala wo.
Ingiese bi tai touzhi Babilun ghadane khighane.'"

content: "Mai xienrenla hontande bikude ganzhen beiku zhanfan wine. Hheshi Huda Musade fenfuladene uzheghasan yanzi mutun gieghasan wo.
Mai xienrenla ene zhanfanyi jienliewo. Huda hhelai melie niman kunlai tou khighasan oronde hhela Yeshuyare hhantu zhanfanyi agi echizhi Dawude honshanni shihou kuruwo.
Huda Dawudede orezho. Ingiese hhe Hudai xiahua giezhi Yagebui houdeilade Huda souku oron zhunbei giene giezhoma,
Hudade giei beighasanshi Sulumane wo."
"Ingiezhoma, Zui Unduni Huda kun khaghalane giesan giede ulie soune. Xienzhi kieliesan kielien mutun wo,

content.text: Enelashi man bi khaghalane giesan pushonu?'"

content: "Ta ene jianbanjin kunla, zhughe, chighindene hetoune ese giesan kunla. Ta xienrenlane mutun ibeizi Shenlinni fandui giezho.
Alinie xienzhilai tai xienrenla ese heiwo? Hhela nie gou kun irene giezhi melie kieliesan xienzhilai alawo. Ede ta hhe gou kunni ghudanduzhi alawo.
Ta qienxienla chonjizhi ogisan guijinni jienliedene ese zunjiwo."
Siqifanni Alazho
Hhela ene kielienyi chenliedene Siqifande hende hokuzhi shidunne zhouzho.
Siqifande Shenlin duruzhi asimanyi xianxide uzhezhi Hudai fama, pse Ersa Hudai borun miende beisei chanladene kieliewo,
"Asiman keizhi Kunnikewon Hudai borun miende beisei bi chanlawo."
Ingiese kunla chighinne duigha fugiede onghonozhi hhei melie chunji echidene
hhei chenshi ghadane tungu khigha tashighala eghi qiiwo. Ganzhen beisan kunla jienne teidene nie Saolo giezhi urusan nasuchighan kunyi kon konde jiewo.
Hhela tashighala eghikude Siqifan onxian giezhi kieliewo, "Ezhan Ersa, mii ruhherni jienlie!"
Pse xiutuliezhi fugiede kieliewo, "Ezhan, ene zuini hhelade bu sougha!" Ene kielienyi kieliedene fuguwo.
